title: CLI skeleton + first command (rubric) under api>cli>sdk discipline
rationale: trellis-0b7c builds src/cli/ as a thin commander surface (SPEC §13.1): zero business logic, all behavior in the domain core. Structure: main.ts buildProgram() registers the SPEC §12 command set; rubric is the one real command (registerRubric in cli/rubric.ts), the rest (audit/drift/fleet/report/standards) are stub() actions that throw CliError(NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Key decisions: (1) global --json/--md live on the root program, read in subcommand actions via this.optsWithGlobals(); resolveFormat() in cli/output.ts maps to OutputFormat 'human'|'json'|'md' and rejects both-set. (2) Output discipline: commands build a Rendered {human,json,md} triple and call emit(format,rendered); they never touch process.stdout directly. (3) Errors: CliError {code,detail{id,file}} + renderError() in output.ts; main.ts uses program.exitOverride() and a run(argv):Promise<number> wrapper that catches CliError -> renderError -> exit code, and passes through commander's CommanderError exitCode (for --help/--version). EXIT={OK:0,ERROR:1} scaffold; --fail-on tuning deferred to trellis-28a5. (4) pino logger (cli/logger.ts) writes to STDERR via pino.destination(2) — critical so --json stdout stays parseable; level from TRELLIS_LOG_LEVEL default warn. (5) The summary fold is CORE not CLI: summarizeRubric() in src/rubric/summary.ts (per-category counts, repo/app split, zero-filled level histogram, gate id) + RUBRIC_VERSION; cli/rubric.ts only renders it. (6) rubric --validate just calls loadRubric (which runs all invariants) and converts RubricError->CliError preserving id+file; success emits summary + valid:true. (7) Testing: Bun.spawn smoke test (cli/main.test.ts) asserts exit codes + JSON shape on real rubric AND a broken temp-dir fixture; broken fixture reached via a HIDDEN --rubric-dir option (Option(...).hideHelp()) so tests can point at alternate rubric dirs without polluting --help. (8) knip.json: removed pino from ignoreDependencies once wired in (per prior toolkit note).

title: Typed SDK + CI exit-code contract (--fail-on) over shared core services
rationale: trellis-28a5 ships src/client/ (audit/drift/fleet/report/rubric + assessReport/assessFleet/loadRubric) as a thin in-process SDK and a CLI exit-code contract. KEY MOVES: (1) Extracted store-lifecycle wrappers into CORE so CLI and SDK share one code path: runAudit (src/report/run.ts), runFleetTargets (src/fleet/run.ts), buildReport (src/history/run.ts) — each opens/closes the store, calls the pure pipeline (auditRepo/runFleet/buildHistory), persists. CLI commands + SDK both call these; the deep-equal test in src/client/index.test.ts proves parity (strip the wall-clock scoredAt before comparing). (2) Exit-code assessment is surface-agnostic core: assessReport (src/report/assess.ts) + assessFleet (src/fleet/assess.ts); activeChecks(mode) maps --fail-on gate|drift|level|none to which dimensions check. Default (flag omitted) = gate OR drift. EXIT={OK:0,ERROR:1,FAIL:2} in cli/output.ts; FailOnExit (thrown AFTER emit so the report still reaches stdout) is caught in main.ts run() before CliError -> writes reasons to stderr, returns code 2. (3) Gate flag (reserved by scorer per SPEC §3.3) is first READ here: gateFails (src/scoring/gate.ts) = measured (counted) AND perCriterionScore<1; N/A gates never fail. FleetTargetOk gained gateFailures:number (computed in orchestrate from rubric gate ids). (4) Introducing the default gate||drift broke ~14 existing output-only CLI tests that asserted exit 0 on sparse fixtures -> added --fail-on none to those. (5) package.json gained an exports map (. + ./client) so @os-eco/trellis-cli/client resolves. (6) File-size ratchet (400) forced splits: drift state vocab+predicates -> src/standards/drift-states.ts; CLI exit-code tests -> exit-codes.test.ts; fleet CLI tests -> fleet.test.ts. Golden snapshots: report JSON (existing) + drift JSON (new, src/standards/__golden__/drift.json, TRELLIS_UPDATE_DRIFT_GOLDEN gate).

title: Audit progress observability via core events + CLI renderer; report file export (--output)
rationale: trellis-9b72: core stays surface-agnostic — auditRepo emits AuditEvent (src/report/progress.ts: phase/apps/detector + lifted InvestigationEvent), runInvestigation emits area-start/cache-hit/probe/session/area-end, and the Pi session loop emits SessionEvent (message/agent-end/retry/heartbeat-stall) via an onEvent sink threaded investigate->fillMiss->onProgress. The CLI owns ALL rendering (src/cli/progress.ts createProgressReporter): TTY-aware default, --quiet suppresses, --verbose adds per-criterion/per-message lines, written to STDERR only so the stdout piping contract is untouched. onProgress is a core option on AuditRunOptions, so the SDK mirrors it for free. --output writes the report to a file (formatForPath infers .json/.md, --json/--md override) while stdout keeps the human summary; writeReportFile wraps IO failures in CliError. Agent-scope projection helpers extracted to src/report/agent-scope.ts to keep build.ts under the 400-line size ratchet.

title: 0.1.0 ships as an MVP promotion release with no code delta
rationale: All 27 plan children of pl-974b had landed across 0.0.1/0.0.2; the 0.1.0 bump exists to mark MVP-complete and trigger the first version-gated npm publish, so the CHANGELOG section summarizes the promoted surface instead of listing new changes.

description: trellis-5b25: process.exit after CLI output truncates reports under pipe backpressure.
resolution: Set process.exitCode and let the event loop drain. src/cli/pipe.test.ts checks reports over 1 MiB against same-run --out artifacts using slow readers and exit codes 0 and 2.

title: CLI --provider flag maps onto the core providers config; unavailable-provider integration tests use a copied CLI install
rationale: The audit CLI exposes provider selection as a repeatable --provider <id[:mode]> flag (trellis-5ee9): flags translate into exactly the declarative providers block the core accepts (providerSelectionFromFlags in src/cli/provider-flags.ts, with the core capability table as the id vocabulary and providerSelectionSchema.parse as the drift belt), applied per provider over trellis.yaml (flagged provider wins, unflagged entries kept). Because the pinned-tool resolver walks node_modules upward from import.meta.dir, an unavailable-resolution run through the real CLI is produced honestly — no stubs — by copying src/ into a temp install whose node_modules symlinks only the runtime deps (commander, js-yaml, typescript, yaml, zod) and omits jscpd; the CLI then resolves unavailable with actionable instructions (exit 0 advisory, exit 2 when policy.requireEvidence demands it).

content: Bundled cleanup guidance is canonical in src/guides/cleanup.ts and shared by CLI guide cleanup and SDK guide(name). Reference it from workflow docs instead of copying it. Keep internal plan/Seeds coordination in repository docs, not emitted guidance used in other repositories.
